mesajlar.mesaj:
Dear people of Glasgow,


As you are aware, a thief going by the name of alanclarks99 recently caused a riot and robbed the city’s treasury.
However, this does not pose any problem. Our wall construction will continue unabated and the public’s demands will be met as before.
Legal proceedings have been initiated against the rebellious thief.
To ensure that this situation does not happen again, new personnel will be assigned to duty every day.
As the commander of the garrison on duty, I will also be on duty every day.


Kind regards.
Odigan
